description: This PHP source file defines the EscaperRuntime class for Twig, implementing string escaping strategies for various contexts (HTML, JavaScript, CSS, etc.) in a templating engine.

classes.name: EscaperRuntime
classes.description: Final class implementing string escaping strategies for Twig's templating engine, managing multiple escaping strategies, safe classes, and encoding conversions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes EscaperRuntime with a default charset (UTF-8).

methods.name: setEscaper
methods.description: Defines a new custom escaper strategy with a callable.

methods.name: setSafeClasses
methods.description: Assigns safe classes with associated strategies, updating internal lookup tables.

methods.name: addSafeClass
methods.description: Adds strategies for a specific class to the safe classes list, updating lookup tables accordingly.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes a given string according to the specified strategy, charset, and context, with handling for safe classes and auto-escaping.

methods.name: convertEncoding
methods.description: Converts string encoding using iconv, with error handling if iconv is unavailable.
